urdu: گواربتی زبان کے کتنے متکلمین پاکستان میں ہیں؟
english: How many speakers of the Gawar-Bati language are there in Pakistan?
roman_1: Gawarbati zaban ke kitne mutakallimeen Pakistan mein hain?
roman_2: Gawarbati zuban ke kitne mutakallimeen Pakistan may hain?
roman_3: Gawarbati zuban ke kitne mutakallimeen Pakistan main hain?
